newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Philips in Romania street lights venture.
newsitem.headline: Philips in Romania street lights venture.

text.p: The Netherlands' Philips Lighting Holding BV, a subsidiary of Philips Electronics, signed a $500,000 deal to set up a joint venture with a private Romanian manufacturer, officials said on Friday.

Philips teamed up with electrical appliance maker Elba SA, based in the western city of Timisoara. The Dutch company will be senior partners, with 55 percent in the new company, Philips & Elba Street Lighting, which will employ 100 Romanians.

"The new company will have a share capital of $500,000 and will start production in October. We plan to win the entire street lighting market in Romania," Elba General Manager Gheorghe Cocean told a news conference in Timisoara, on the western border with Hungary and Yugoslavia.
Cocean said the new venture would also tap Philips' foreign markets to export its products. Elba, fully owned by its 2,400 employees, has 60 percent of Romania's street lighting.
